bdlc_crc: model 1, CRC32 of pixels in header
rvc: legacy RVC codec.py, tile 64, spatial mode on
blosc2_zstd_bitshuffle: blosc2 zstd level 9, bitshuffle, typesize 2, 1 thread
jpegxl7: JPEG XL lossless effort 7, 1 thread, bare codestream
jpegxl9: JPEG XL lossless effort 9, 1 thread, bare codestream
jpegxl10: JPEG XL lossless effort 10, 1 thread, bare codestream
ecc_pi: ECC-2026 (InterDigital fe3f2f1 + docker/patches/ecc_ub_fixes.patch), pi(x) as 8-bit YUV 4:0:0, 1 frame; label set sigma*(K)
ecc_direct: ECC-2026, label values <= 255 as 8-bit YUV 4:0:0 (ECC stores its palette)
hevc_scc_pi: HM-16.21+SCM-8.8, encoder_intra_main_scc.cfg, lossless (transquant bypass, CostMode lossless), palette on, 4:0:0 8-bit pi(x); label set sigma*(K)
jbig_gray_pi: JBIG-KIT 2.1 pbmtojbg -q (sequential), bit planes of pi(x), Gray code; label set sigma*(K)
jbig_binary_pi: JBIG-KIT 2.1 pbmtojbg -q -b, bit planes of pi(x), binary code; label set sigma*(K)
flif_pi_e60: FLIF 0.4, 8-bit PGM of pi(x), effort 60; label set sigma*(K)
flif_pi_e100: FLIF 0.4, 8-bit PGM of pi(x), effort 100; label set sigma*(K)
compresso: Compresso b1f7fd6 via docker/cpso_cli.cpp: Python-package defaults (Fortran order, steps 4x4x1, connectivity 4, z index)

parameters.null_run: 1x1 map, repeats pairs, per codec (CLI fixed cost, Q1 1.6)
parameters.phases: size phase: all images, 20 parallel unpinned-priority workers (sizes are deterministic); then timing phase: pinned single CPU, sequential, nothing else running
